pack.name: SAP implementation options
pack.description: Illustrative SAP product mappings to stable Composer responsibilities; technical fit evidence is kept separate from commercial preference.

evidence.title: SAP-to-Composer role mapping method
evidence.note: Illustrative product-to-role mapping for architecture exploration; it is not vendor documentation, procurement advice or a claim of universal product fit.

guidance.statement: SAP S/4HANA is represented only as a candidate implementation option for the Composer ERP responsibility, not as an automatic architecture decision.
SAP Integration Suite is represented only as a candidate implementation option for the Composer integration-platform responsibility.

options.name: SAP S/4HANA
options.description: Candidate implementation for the transactional ERP responsibility in the Composer reference model.

fitEvidence.statement: The option is mapped to the transactional ERP responsibility; actual scope and product fit still require project-specific validation.

options.name: SAP Master Data Governance
options.description: Candidate implementation for the master-data governance responsibility in the Composer reference model.

fitEvidence.statement: The option is mapped to the MDM responsibility when governed shared master data is part of the composed target architecture.

options.name: SAP Integration Suite
options.description: Candidate implementation for the integration-platform responsibility in the Composer reference model.

fitEvidence.statement: The option is mapped to the integration-platform responsibility; protocol, runtime, governance and operating-model fit remain separate decisions.
